item.title: SPANISH, Debbie-Lynn
item.description: It is with deep sadness that we announce the passing of Debbie-Lynn Spanish, who passed away on Monday, March 16, 2026, at the age of 54. Debbie was a loving and devoted mother, grandmother, sister, and friend.

item.title: LAURIN, Gabriel
item.description: (1945 – 2026) C’est avec une grande tristesse que la famille vous annonce son décès, le 22 mars 2026, à l’âge de 80 ans.

item.title: Treaty chiefs call for moratorium on aerial glyphosate use across their territory
item.description: First Nations leaders are urging Ontario to reconsider how industrial herbicide use is permitted under provincial forestry rules, arguing it conflicts with their laws and responsibilities as stewards of the land

item.title: ‘Muzzling the process’: Ontario didn’t contribute to Ring of Fire assessment
item.description: Ontario has not been involved in the federal government’s regional assessment of the Ring of Fire, withholding scientific data and funding needed to understand the impact of mining development, even as the province ushers it through.

item.title: Celebration of Life: COTNOIR, Denis
item.description: Please join us in Celebrating the Life of Denis Cotnoir, a person who brought so much love, laughter, and unforgettable moments to those around him. A Celebration of Life will be held on March 28th, 2026 The church service will take place at 11:00 a.m.

item.title: BRADLEY, François
item.description: C’est avec regret que la famille annonce le décès le 18 mars, 2026 dernier de François Bradley, fils bien aimé de Nelson et Marie (Brosseau) Bradley.

item.title: HOGAN, Leonard
item.description: May 1944 – March 2026 (81) In Loving Memory of Leonard Hogan, 81 years, who passed away at his home in Sudbury ON, March 8th, 2026. He will be lovingly remembered by his son Neil Hogan.

item.title: BELL, Colin
item.description: With heavy hearts, we remember Colin Bell, who passed away suddenly on March 16, 2026. Colin had a gift for making people laugh—his incredible sense of humour and contagious laugh could brighten even the dullest day.
